	xx = [i for i in range(0,Nwavs)]
	bin_labels = [f'im {i+1}' for i in range(0,Nims)]

	fig, ax = plt.subplots(nrows=1, ncols=1, figsize=(5,5))
	ax.imshow(MixingMatrix, cmap='magma')
	ax.set_xticks(xx)
	ax.set_yticks(xx)
